collections.title: Beef
collections.description: Our beef collection is focused on rich flavour, quality ingredients and high-protein meals made fresh each week. Using lean beef and slow-cooked recipes for maximum tenderness and flavour, these meals are designed to be satisfying, macro-friendly and convenient without sacrificing that homemade feel.

collections.title: Chicken
collections.description: Our chicken collection features fresh, high-protein meals made to order each week using quality ingredients and bold flavours. From creamy pasta dishes to balanced bowls and lighter options, every meal is designed to be convenient, satisfying and macro-friendly without feeling like typical meal prep.

collections.title: Lamb
collections.description: Our lamb collection brings together bold flavour and high-protein convenience using quality lean lamb and fresh ingredients. Each meal is made fresh to order and designed to be satisfying, balanced and full of flavour without feeling heavy.

collections.title: Meals for Sunday Delivery
collections.description:
Meals prepared fresh and delivered Sunday, ready to set you up for the week ahead.

This collection includes our range of macro-balanced, high-protein meals, all cooked from scratch, portioned with precision and packed for freshness. Designed for busy schedules, each meal is made to order and delivered chilled, so you can simply heat and enjoy throughout the week.

Perfect for stocking up, most clients order 5–8 meals to stay on track with their nutrition.

collections.title: Meals for Wednesday Delivery
collections.description:
Meals prepared fresh and delivered mid-week so you’re covered for the second half of your week.

This collection is part of your same weekly order, designed to keep your meals as fresh as possible by spacing out delivery. These dishes are cooked to order, portioned with precision, and delivered chilled on Wednesday.

Pair this with your Sunday delivery to stay stocked with fresh, macro-balanced meals all week, no compromises on quality or taste.

collections.title: Seafood
collections.description: Our seafood collection is made for those wanting lighter, fresh and flavour-packed meals without compromising on protein. Using quality seafood and fresh ingredients, each dish is made to order weekly and designed to feel balanced, satisfying and full of homemade flavour.

collections.title: This Week's Menu Drop
collections.description: Order this week’s made-to-order meal prep in Sydney. High protein, macro balanced meals designed for busy professionals and gym goers. Limited spots available each week.
